title: JoinandQuit
description: This is a plugin use to costumize join and quit messages on your server
body:
# JoinAndQuit – Customizable Join & Quit Messages

**JoinAndQuit is a lightweight and fully customizable Minecraft plugin that enhances your server by providing beautiful and dynamic join and quit messages.**

With this plugin, you can easily personalize how players are welcomed and how they leave your server, making your community feel more engaging and professional.

# ✨ Features

Fully customizable join and quit messages

Supports color codes (&a, &b, etc.)

Supports HEX colors for modern servers

Placeholder support (player name, etc.)

Toggle join/quit messages on or off

Lightweight and optimized for performance

Easy-to-use configuration

# 💡 Why use JoinAndQuit?

Default Minecraft messages are plain and boring. JoinAndQuit allows you to create unique and eye-catching messages that match your server’s theme and style, helping improve player experience and first impressions.

# ⚙️ Configuration

Simply edit the config.yml file to customize messages to your liking. No complicated setup required.

# 📌 Perfect for:

Survival servers

SMP servers

Minigame servers

Community servers

# 📱 Command

- `/jaq reload` - reload the new config.yml settings
